text: 政治局会议释放政策加力信号；长鑫科技上市刷新A股纪录｜一周热点回顾 其他热点还有：商务部发布文件，驳斥所谓“产能过剩”；韩国股市罕见连续两日熔断，政府密集表态稳定市场。
text_en: Politburo Meeting Signals Policy Boost; ChangXin Memory Tech IPO Sets A-Share Record | Weekly Highlights: Other news includes MOFCOM document refuting so-called 'overcapacity'; Korean stock market sees rare two-day circuit breaker, with government statements to stabilize market.
